plugins.cameraPermission: Deckhead uses the camera to scan deck codes, take photos for your own cards, and, if you turn it on, film the room during a round. Everything stays on your phone unless you share it.
plugins.microphonePermission: Deckhead uses the microphone only for features you turn on: sound for the round videos you choose to film, and the voice referee, which recognises speech on your iPhone itself. Nothing is sent anywhere.

plugins.motionPermission: Deckhead uses motion only for the optional tilt controls, to tell when you tip the phone to answer. Nothing is recorded.

plugins.microphonePermission: Deckhead uses the microphone only for features you turn on: sound for the round videos you choose to film, and the voice referee, which recognises speech on your iPhone itself. Nothing is sent anywhere.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Deckhead’s optional voice referee listens for card words during a round. Speech is recognised on your iPhone itself and never sent anywhere.

plugins.photosPermission: Deckhead lets you pick photos for your own cards. They stay on your phone, inside your decks.
